defects.title: Dropped records
defects.description: 8 policies and 1 account(s) never loaded; the dropped account(s) took their policies with them.

defects.title: Duplicated accounts
defects.description: 2 accounts loaded twice under new ids.

defects.title: Doubled premium
defects.description: Mapping bug: every semi-annual policy's annual premium was multiplied by 2.

defects.title: Unmapped plan codes
defects.description: 3 legacy policies carry plan codes TL15 and GUL, which the value map lacks; they loaded with a blank product.

defects.title: Date-format shift
defects.description: One load batch read issue dates as DD/MM: day and month swapped where the day is 12 or less, blank where it is more.

defects.title: Truncated names
defects.description: Account names longer than 30 characters were cut at 30.
